name: MAYHEM
source:
School life proceed as usual with the loneliness feeling flying in the air. Two persons gradually get closer in these circumstances, and it starts to affect human relationships around them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
校园生活照常继续，孤独感弥漫在空气中。在这样的环境里，两个人逐渐靠近，开始影响身边的人际关系。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
